propositions: The CLI architecture decision must establish a single immutable top-level route registry with lazy handler and parser-factory module:function references, replacing repeated CLI censuses with shared authority.

Parser-derived help must be generated from stdlib argparse factories as the sole grammar source for both runtime parsing and committed package help, with no separate docs DSL or unchecked syntax authority.
CLI routing for help, aliases, and unknown commands must execute before RP-04 operation-snapshot, config, store mount, and optional handler imports.
The semantic capability registry must map to packaging extras and enforce one of four postures (error, unavailable, abstain, fallback) only after the selected mode/backend is known.

ADR 0100 must record the maintainer-approved design verbatim without adding decisions, resolve all research critique items before drafting, and pass both document oracle checks (adr-number bijection and index generation) before Gerrit Submit.
